ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Swalah? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Swalah.
   B. Use Pillars of Swalah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Pillars of Swalah has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Swalah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Attributes of Allah.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
